items.action: Remove the `staggerMs` attribute or `[staggerMs]` binding from every ds-pie-chart.
items.appliesWhen: ds-pie-chart only. `staggerMs` on the other charts and on the chart series is unchanged and still spaces their arrivals.
items.verify: No ds-pie-chart element carries a staggerMs attribute or binding, and the app compiles.

informational.text: A toast's announcement stays off screen from the first toast on a page. ToastService speaks through the CDK LiveAnnouncer, whose region carries .cdk-visually-hidden, and the CDK loads that rule only with a dialog or a focus trap, so until one opened the announcement rendered as text at the page's bottom-left. styles/toast-overlay, which styles/ds forwards, declares the rule, and an app's own include of it is redundant (delete list: cdk-visually-hidden-include).
informational.verify: On a freshly loaded page, show a toast before opening any dialog: .cdk-live-announcer-element measures 1x1 px and the toast text appears nowhere else on the page.

deleteList.why: styles/toast-overlay, which styles/ds forwards, declares .cdk-visually-hidden for the announcer region ToastService writes to, so an app-level include of the CDK rule restates it.
deleteList.replaceWith: nothing; keep it where the app loads neither styles/ds nor styles/toast-overlay
